entry_state: A method can be locally correct yet yield a wrong composed simulation when its inputs change meaning. Carrying amount is not face value, valuation is not cash, an allowance is not borrowing eligibility, particles are not a full robust domain, and a solver tolerance is not a contractual threshold. Every interface must preserve the relevant identity, domain, timing and interpretation.
exit_state: The combined financing case checks dated cash, face, carrying amounts and ownership separately. Nominal credit schedules remain after financial write-off; later recovery and the separate insurance stage ledger still require their own evidence and dated interfaces. The next chapter introduces a two-state risky-debt model with explicit creditor priority and risk-neutral pricing.
